s00875.summary: Lieutenant Nwosu joins cook Bellamy in the crypt kitchen and they joke about rabbit stew.
They listen to distant artillery, and Bellamy says you only pretend to get used to it.
Bellamy serves her stew and they trade small jokes about writing home.
Nwosu admits she cannot finish a letter to her brother because she fears being good at war.
Bellamy urges her to write the truth, and she begins writing.
Nwosu thanks him for the rabbit and laughs quietly as she keeps writing.

s00625.summary: A tense crew in the pump house races the watchman's round to crack a vault.

s00983.summary: Inspector Augustine has Pru retell what she saw the night the barge vanished.
Halvorsen calls to say the barge is found with only a woman's boot aboard.
Augustine eyes Pru's feet and orders her to remove her boots.
Pru laughs and reveals she swapped into her mother's boots, resolving the mystery.

s00380.summary: Leilani records her nightly log in a nearly empty toll booth, playing back her old hopeful message.
She confesses her job was eliminated weeks ago and she keeps the arm up unpaid.
She switches off the fan, says she is going home, and leaves the recorder glowing.

s00852.summary: Duane takes scripted calls while Shanice mocks his empty phrases.
Kovacs's intercom scolding about handle time draws muttered sarcasm and snorts.
Duane and Shanice drop their headsets and quietly confront Kovacs's evasions.
They tear down the motivational banner together, ignoring the intercom.

s01534.summary: Doctor Horatio visits Euphemia in the solarium and they trade dry remarks about roses.
Horatio says the results are bad; Euphemia presses his hand and refuses to hear them.
Horatio asks to visit on Thursdays too, and Euphemia agrees obliquely.
They sit in stillness until Horatio asks someone to turn the gramophone record.

s00113.summary: Admiral Selene takes reports from the terraforming crew as a storm approaches.
Earth Control says the silent Observer was registered dead decades ago.
The crew rises as the Observer calmly claims clerical error and says he watches what follows them.

s01265.summary: Detective Marlowe-Diaz questions pawnbroker Solomon about a delivery.
Victor enters the pawnshop; nervous Tipper whispers that he is the one.
Everyone freezes as Cleo and Victor speak and the detective eyes the safe.

s00079.summary: Dr. Helene sits by patient Rosalind during dialysis and makes stilted small talk.
Rosalind says Helene asks the thing next to the thing, like her father.
Their hands touch on the call button; Helene takes the book and reads aloud.

s01420.summary: Delphine nervously serves tea to her mismatched lost-property colleagues in the basement.
Delphine gives chirpy non-answers about the locked door and shut-off elevator.
Barnaby spots the folder with five names and the five matching cups.
Delphine slides the folder across, steady; the umbrella tags begin ticking.

s00970.summary: Keziah climbs into the flooded belfry with a stolen moon-ember and is kissed.
The bell hums wrongly and the water begins rising fast.
Orsolya shoves Keziah to the rope and persuades him to ring the bell.
The bell drives the tide back and they laugh in relief.
A furious drowned choir begins singing and the two run.

s00716.summary: Leona accuses Pascal of taking their father's watch in the attic.
They tug a box of photographs between them until it spills.
Gathering photos, they tease about Pascal's childhood haircut and hiding in the car.
Pascal offers the watch; Leona admits she just doesn't want to be alone.

s00088.summary: Toll keeper Brynmor whittles on his step as a pilgrim crosses the bone bridge.
Asked for a true thing as toll, Tallis admits he fears he will finish nothing.
Brynmor accepts the answer and serves Tallis tea.
The lantern brightens, a far light appears, and Tallis thanks him and crosses.

s01817.summary: Travelers idle at the ferry landing, bantering about the river and departure time.
Holloway mutters that it won't be long now, unsettling the others.
Three riders appear and Holloway reveals a deputy's badge.
Mrs. Priest pulls a revolver from her hatbox as the gunmen ride down.

s02187.summary: Father and daughter play chess in quiet candlelit companionship and speak of her mother.
Captain Ashby enters late from Waterloo; Catherine grips a pawn.
Edmund bids Ashby sit as Catherine steadies the toppled rook and says check.

s00480.summary: Dex makes weight at the wrestling weigh-in and Coach Bellwether feeds him.
Bellwether asks to see the scale certification and finds it expired.
After Priya leaves, Bellwether tells worried Dex to eat and tests the scale.
Bellwether shows the scale drifts seven pounds and accuses Ramón of rejecting her wrestlers.
Priya returns saying the certification was never renewed and Ramón sits down.

s02475_0.summary: A helicopter lands and the medic hands off a critically injured fall victim.
The dying man asks for his boy and gives his name, Desmond Achebe.

s01312.summary: Yasmine lingers alone on a parked school bus after graduation.
She answers her mother's call and avoids saying why she is still there.
Coach Abara arrives for his keys and lingers while her mother thanks him.
Yasmine asks Coach to drive her to the restaurant and he starts the bus.

s02136.summary: After a flood crisis, operators reassure shaken new Hattie.
Maude and Miss Calloway push frightened Hattie to take the next call.
Hattie takes a flooded caller's report and tells her to take the children upstairs.
Miss Calloway praises Hattie as the women plug into more calls and she finally sits.

s02088.summary: Travelers idle at a dusty stage station while Casper whittles for his granddaughter.
Passengers joke about waiting for the horses and the railroad schedule.
Everyone watches a hawk wheel overhead and Casper calls it a duck in a hurry.

s01391.summary: Mama Rosalie burns pancakes and her boys joke about the crispy breakfast.
A man in a rumpled suit knocks and Rosalie recognizes Amos.
Wary Tucker hides while Ben, after his mother's nod, runs to Amos.

s01307.summary: Peter finds Dr. Linden devastated in the garage after losing a young patient.
She recalls the dead boy and his dog Rocket.
Peter sits beside her and offers to cover her shift.

s00487.summary: Sully returns an eleven-years-overdue book to Maeve's bookmobile.
Maeve declines her husband's calls and Sully learns she is married.
Sully admits he wrote in the margins and Maeve reads his line.
They joke about the late fee; Sully offers installments.
Maeve turns off her phone and stays, not telling him to leave.

s01718.summary: Four exhausted survivors drift in a lifeboat and spot a gull.
A seaplane appears and the pilot shouts that he is dropping a line.

s02489.summary: Jojo teases wobbly Tariq at the roller rink on its last night.
Jojo tells Tariq the rink has been sold, and they argue over who stopped talking.
Tariq apologizes for the cafeteria, and Jojo pulls him away from the wall.
They skate together and Mr. Lindqvist bargains five more minutes.
Jojo reveals her family moves to Tucson in June.
Tariq begs for one more lap and Lindqvist kills the music.

s00476.summary: Okonkwo's squad moves silently through a ruined opera house.
A wounded enemy soldier staggers out with hands raised, begging.
Tran treats him while Okonkwo questions Petrescu, who says his unit is coming for the radio.
Achterberg spots a mortar team; Okonkwo gives orders and the squad scatters.

s00650.summary: Three strangers are stuck in a stalled elevator and the intercom promises maintenance.
The intercom asks about a bag, Brynja clutches her briefcase, and the car is too heavy.
